summary: abrdn Global Infrastructure Income Fund (NYSE: ASGI) filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, disclosing a Dealer Manager Agreement with UBS Securities LLC for a transferable rights offering of up to 10,545,755 common shares. Record date holders received one right per share, exercisable at one new share per three rights, with oversubscription privileges. A prospectus supplement dated September 21, 2026 supplements the September 15, 2026 shelf prospectus. Equiniti and EQ Fund Solutions serve as subscription and information agents. Terms such as subscription price and expiration date are not stated in the excerpt. Watch for subscription price, expiry, and dilution risk.
